TOOLING BURST T0-d3 — O3b annulus discrimination (SPEC § 6 row "T0-d lane extensions", the T0-d3 clause; owed by ledger R-5). task_id "T0-d3".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0 constraints, § 1 result schema, § 4 (O3 row + acceptance), § 6 the "T0-d lane extensions" row: the T0-d3 clause is your whole contract.
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md
3. astra_test_01/burst/oracles/motif.py, oracles/common.py, oracles/CALIBRATION.md, tests/motif_calibration.py, tests/o3b_calibration.json, tests/test_oracles_motif.py, tests/test_compare.py, compare/compare_to_bible.py, fixtures/manifest.json, fixtures/{f04_advanced_crop.png, clean_crop.png}.
Do not read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, role files, the charter, or anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY.

THE DEFECT (conductor diagnosis from peak overlays): `count_family` at vote_thresh 0.50 finds 1 peak on the clean crop — the mage's front boot toe, centre (286,407), radius 8 — and among the 14 outside peaks on the F04 crop it counts the face (~(125,83) r 20), a fist (~(82,418) r 17) and both boot toes (~(69,547) r 14, ~(232,626) r 18). These are FILLED convex shapes, not rings. The genuine ring-sigils (pauldron emblem ~(152,173) r 13, chest boss ~(113,201) r 30, tabard compass ~(111,311) r 27, belt buckle ~(170,253) r 8, rod head (212,393) r 27 inside) must keep counting.

BUILD:
A. oracles/motif.py — add an annulus test to `count_family` (a named parameter, e.g. `hollow_min`, with a calibration note in CALIBRATION.md): a ring has an INNER edge at 0.4–0.85 r whose radial gradient sign opposes the outer edge's, and/or a centre disc (within 0.5 r) whose Lab colour is closer to the surround than to the ring band; a filled disc has neither. Each candidate peak must pass the test to count; rejected peaks are reported in `peaks[]` with `rejected: "not_annulus"` and the measured statistic so the conductor can audit them. Keep everything else in count_family unchanged (radii, vote_thresh 0.50, NMS, mask partition).
B. tests/motif_calibration.py — the synthetic set gains FILLED DISCS at the same three radii (r 8, 14, 22) on the flat and the textured background (each must count 0) beside the rings (each must count), keeping the half-arc control. The annulus threshold is chosen from THESE synthetic observations, recorded in tests/o3b_calibration.json, BEFORE any real-crop measurement — then held fixed.
C. Acceptance (SPEC § 4, unchanged): F04 crop with allowed=[rod_head bbox] → outside ≥ 3; clean_crop → outside == 0; compare_to_bible with the stub FAILS the F04 crop and PASSES the clean crop. Report the new F04 outside count and list which of the previous 14 peaks dropped (by centre). Do NOT tune anything to the real crops; if the acceptance is not met, report the numbers.
D. Update tests/test_oracles_motif.py (add the filled-disc cases), tests/test_compare.py as needed, oracles/CALIBRATION.md (a T0-d3 section), tests/oracles_acceptance_measurements.json via the suite.
E. Run the FULL suite: `cd astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected ALL green; report exact counts.

DO NOT touch: lane/, gates/, parts/, transcribe/, bible/, compare/calibrate_transcriber.py, the other oracles, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, runs/, briefs/, fixtures/ (read-only). Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under tests/tmp/.

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T0-d3"): files = every created/modified file with sha256 (absolute paths under astra_test_01/burst; the wrapper verifies them in place); images []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns must name precisely any acceptance case not met, with its number. Never PASS/FAIL.
